subject: Release memo — f00tils 0.16.9
ref: Arch zsh bare-name PATH, packaging/shell, v0.16.8
opening: Bottom line: 0.16.9 makes package replace work immediately after paru/pacman for zsh terminals. Root cause: Arch non-login zsh never loads /etc/profile.d, so only login shells got /usr/lib/f00/bin. Ship /etc/zsh/zshenv + shared path.sh so find/grep/diff/ls resolve to f00 with no user steps.

sections.heading: 1. Problem
sections.body: which find → /usr/bin/find after install; users expected coreutils-like bare-name replace for the full suite.

sections.heading: 2. Fix
items: profile.d + fish conf.d unchanged purpose; path logic centralized
Tarball ships share/f00 hooks for AUR/nfpm
Still no overwrite of /usr/bin/find (no file conflicts with findutils)

steps.text: paru -S f00 (or upgrade); open new terminal (no source required)

sections.heading: 4. Install
sections.body: curl -fsSL https://coreutils.f00.sh/install.sh | bash · pin F00_VERSION=v0.16.9 · AUR: f00
